messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH metering.alert token_count_drift — region=eu1. Threshold breached: +12% vs baseline. Auto-runbook invoked.
maya_oncall: I’m on it — seeing a token emission amplification in EU. Starting triage.
sam_eng: pulling logs and metrics now.
lee_billing: FYI: overage flags fired for ~11 customers in EU1, some received auto-notifications.
tara_support: we already have 3 customer escalations in the queue. standing by for comms.
maya_oncall: quick check: kafka consumer lag = 0, emitter_queue_depth normal, but proxy retry_count +230% last 10m.
sam_eng: metric query I ran: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted{region="eu1"}[5m])) by (service)
```
sam_eng: result: ~1.12M tokens/5m vs baseline ~980k (≈+14%). aligns with drift.
oliver_sre: any recent deploys around 06:10 UTC?
maya_oncall: no deploys in last 24h.
sam_eng: tracing shows bursts of duplicate emit events from emitter-proxy v2.7.3 -> duplicates surface as new tokens.
maya_oncall: mitigation plan: route emitter traffic to eu-failover cluster for 5m and cap proxy retries (max_retries=2).
sam_eng: applying retry cap now and switching route.
incident-bot: Action: take billing notifications on hold while investigating (see runbook step 4).
lee_billing: pausing auto-overage notifications and flagging affected accounts as 'investigating'. will stop any outbound email sends. :white_check_mark:
tara_support: sending hold notice to impacted customers (template HOLD_MET_01) — no further action requested yet.
sam_eng: throttle applied. retry_count down to ~1.1x, tokens_emitted trending back toward baseline (observed drop in 90s).
maya_oncall: monitoring feed. @lee_billing — do you want provisional credits queued?
lee_billing: yes please prepare a provisional credit plan (pro-rata for window). won’t finalize until we know total duration.
oliver_sre: collection checklist: save proxy v2.7.3 logs, emitter traces, kafka offsets, and token aggregation snapshots.
maya_oncall: will collect and upload to incident CID: INC-1755556789.
tara_support: CS template v3 primed for followup once we have root cause.
sam_eng: root cause candidate: regression in retry logic in proxy v2.7.3 that amplifies duplicate emits when downstream acks are flapping.
maya_oncall: severity P2 (billing visible to small subset of customers). containment in progress.
oliver_sre: I’ll take 2nd-line handoff in 25m for overnight monitoring and postmortem follow-up. @maya_oncall handing over summary.
maya_oncall: copy — handing off to @oliver_sre in 25m with a short summary + artifacts.
lee_billing: will prepare customer list and draft compensation memo.
incident-bot: Incident update posted to channel and incident tracker: #inc-1755556789.
maya_oncall: thanks all — will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
